r_to_lambda.doc: Invert lambda_to_r: map a radial coordinate to a wavelength.

params.intensities: up to 8 intensities, one per NIRCam filter in filter order; missing components are 0

spectral_to_octonion.returns: dict with the octonion components, the norm |Ψ| = √ΣI² and the radial address of each filter

octonion_to_spectral.returns: dict of spectral intensities at the filter wavelengths

cd_spectral_address.returns: dict with the ℝ, ℂ, ℍ and 𝕆 layers and the pixel coordinates as a base-100 pair

synthetic_spectrum.returns: dict with the filter intensities of the synthetic spectrum
